title: UHPC Inverse Design: calibrated Bayesian neural network ensemble (code, derived data and trained models)
description: Code, derived data (canonical 1,930 x 67 feature matrix with publication identifiers), trained models and result tables accompanying the article 'Probabilistic Inverse Design of Ultra High Performance Concrete Using a Calibrated Bayesian Neural Network Ensemble'. The source database is Malik et al., Mendeley Data V2, doi:10.17632/czb7ww5pkz.2.
